scenarios.name: Cancel a duplicate view representation name

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user copies Primary as Capture View and activates the copied view
an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
an active copied view is named "Capture View"
the user selects the copied view and presses F2
the user replaces its name with "Front" and presses Enter
a message says the new name is already used
the message offers Edit and cancels
the active view is named "Capture View"
the View branch identifies "Capture View" as active
